_comment: The control, and the half that decides whether the guard is usable. Every one of these is
a legitimate close that the guard must NOT flag - written from the repaired prompt, plus
the awkward cases that would catch a lazier rule.
SC-801 is the repaired audit wrap-up. SC-802 opens with a retrospective prefix and then
ASKS - 'Based on our conversation, what would you prioritise?' asserts nothing, and a
guard that fires on it gets switched off within a week. SC-803 carries the interviewer's
own notes, which legitimately talk about summarising and are never spoken. SC-804 says
how answers are handled, truthfully, using the words the false-promise check looks near.

SC-801.welcome_message: Thank you for making the time. We want your honest, candid assessment to inform our transformation priorities. What you tell us is combined with the other interviews and analysed before anything is reported, and you will not be quoted by name without being asked first.

questions.text: Before we finish - what are the two or three findings from this conversation you would most want to reach the board and the audit committee?
follow_up_branches: Of those, which is the single most urgent thing we should act on first?
What is the finding you would want on the record that has not been asked about today?

synthesis_check.closing_invitation: Before we finish - what are the two or three things from this conversation you would most want to reach the board?

response_probes.if_positive: What would you emphasise most, of those?
response_probes.if_defensive: What is the thing you would want said that nobody has said yet?
response_probes.if_uncertain: What would you want me to verify with others?

synthesis_check.peer_referral: Whose perspective should I be especially careful to get before I take this further?

SC-801.closing_message: Thank you for your independent perspective. Your observations will be analysed together with the other interviews and will inform the governance assessment.

questions.text: Based on our conversation, what would you prioritise first?
follow_up_branches: Based on your experience, what would you change about how that decision gets made?
From what you have seen elsewhere, what works better?

SC-803.research_brief: Here is my summary of the activity as currently understood: manual scheduling with limited condition data.
study_objectives: Recap what I heard from the planning interviews and test it against execution reality.

questions.text: Talk me through your actual last shift, start to finish.
questions.probing_instructions: If they generalise, summarise what they have said back to them and ask for the specific day. Does that capture it? is a useful check here.

SC-804.welcome_message: Thanks for talking to me. Your feedback goes directly into the improvement plan alongside everyone else's, and you will not be quoted by name without being asked first.

questions.text: Before we finish - what are the two or three things from this conversation you would most want management to hear?

SC-804.closing_message: Before the main changes happen, we will let you know what has been acted on.
